facts.fact: The World Bank's ISR reports the social registry indicator (target 60% of existing social protection beneficiaries by Sep 2025) at 0% on 30-May-2025, pending the ASP Management Information System, with the program being restructured to put more emphasis on the social registry.

note: The article names ASP's existing beneficiary registry for REPAIR cash transfers but does not say it serves two or more programmes or call it a social registry.
